# BAD-058 — Take-row download button on the web Scene screen opens the same Audio / Video / Vertical reel menu as the screening room

## Brief
Eric (2026-09-15): on my.badtakes.io the download button on each row of the Scene screen's "Your takes" list ("Save this dub", web/app-takes.js renderHistory) only saves the mix as a WAV. It should work the same way as the download button in the screening room (recorded take view): a menu offering Audio, Video and Vertical reel (web/index.html #export-menu, wired in web/app.js to exportVideo / exportReel and the audio export).

Done when the take-row button opens that same three-item menu and each choice produces the same file the screening room's menu produces for that take, without the user having to open the take first; the WAV-only path is gone from the row.

## Size, persona and model decision
One engineer on opus: a UI change in web/ reusing the screening room's existing export paths; no separable parts.
